newsitem.title: INDIA: India says to clear postal backlog in 48 hours.
newsitem.headline: India says to clear postal backlog in 48 hours.

text.p: India's telecommunications department on Wednesday announced emergency measures to clear the backlog mail of 13 million pieces within 48 hours as postal workers resumed work after a week-long strike.
The telecommunications department said in a statement the loss on account of the strike was estimated at around 200 ($5.6 million) to 240 million rupees.
A core group of five senior officials has been formed to clear the backlog of mail, it said.
About one million postal and telephone workers called off their seven-day strike late on Tuesday after the government decided to remove a ceiling on bonus payments.
A government statement said on Tuesday employees would be paid a productivity-linked bonus.

The strike started on October 23 in protest of a decision to impose a 3,500-rupee ceiling on annual pay bonuses. It crippled government postal services, with millions of letters piling up in post offices across India.
